mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.0% fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 45% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in labor market strength (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a synchronized economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in PAYEMS and RSAFS fails to produce negative returns in more than 40% of instances, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0% for 3 consecutive months), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 35% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction (HOUST) over the past 6 months indicates robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: HOUST growth fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings visibility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 105.0 fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 45% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a severe economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint rise in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE fails to produce negative returns in more than 40% of instances, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (RSAFS above 500,000 and UNRATE below 3.5%), stretched equity valuations lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.01.
